label:fireworks.name: 🎆 Fireworks
label:fireworks.short: Both teams’ {segment}s usually go Over. ‘Usually’ = 60%+ of their games, 5+ played.

label:fireworks_btts.name: 🎆 Fireworks (BTTS)
label:fireworks_btts.short: In both teams’ {segment}s, both teams usually score. ‘Usually’ = 60%+ of their games, 5+ played.

label:lockdown.name: 🔒 Lockdown
label:lockdown.short: Both teams’ {segment}s usually go Under. ‘Usually’ = 60%+ of their games, 5+ played.

label:lockdown_btts.name: 🔒 Lockdown (BTTS)
label:lockdown_btts.short: In both teams’ {segment}s, usually not both teams score. ‘Usually’ = 60%+ of their games, 5+ played.

label:mismatch.name: 🥊 Mismatch
label:mismatch.short: One team usually wins the {segment}, the other usually loses it.

label:tug_of_war.name: 🪢 Tug of war
label:tug_of_war.short: One team’s {segment}s usually go Over, the other’s usually go Under.

label:tug_of_war_btts.name: 🪢 Tug of war (BTTS)
label:tug_of_war_btts.short: In one team’s {segment}s both teams usually score; in the other’s, usually not both teams score.
